clue.text: Support armed robbery

definitions.meaning: to prop or bear the weight of something
a raid at gunpoint on a bank, coach or shop

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the phrase means to prop up; as a noun it is a stick-up by gunmen.

clue.text: Stop and take a firm grip of things

definitions.meaning: an old command to halt or wait

definitions.text: take a firm grip of things
definitions.meaning: read literally, clutch tightly

explanation.surface: Advice to someone losing control: halt and get a grip.
explanation.definitionFit: An old exclamation telling someone to halt, and literally to clasp tightly.

clue.text: Briefly visited-that's what Peeping Tom did

definitions.meaning: called round for a short while
the voyeur of the Godiva legend peered through a window

explanation.surface: A short social call compared with a famous voyeur's spying.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means paid a short call; literally it describes peering through a window, as the legendary voyeur did.

clue.text: A hut constructed near the Rockies

indicators.note: something constructed is put together, so these letters are assembled into a new order

explanation.surface: A cabin built in mountain country.
explanation.definitionFit: The state lies in the western US, its eastern half in the mountain range.

clue.text: Punch needed once cobbler has carved leather for top of shoe

parts.note: the upper is the part of a shoe above the sole
carved means cut

explanation.surface: A shoemaker cutting leather for the top of a shoe.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxing blow thrown upward at the opponent's chin.

clue.text: Copper disc listing criminal offences

parts.note: copper is slang for a police officer, here the force
a disc is a gramophone record

explanation.surface: A metal disc that lists crimes, like a charge sheet.
explanation.definitionFit: The file of past convictions held on a person by the authorities.

clue.text: Everyone heartens a preacher

indicators.note: read as the heart of the following word, so its central letters are taken

explanation.surface: Every member of a congregation is encouraged by a preacher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartens' looks like 'encourages' but asks for the heart of 'preacher', its middle four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken one at a time, every person is meant.

clue.text: Hurry up and invite boarders

definitions.meaning: a call urging someone to get a move on
a call welcoming people aboard or inside

explanation.surface: A ship's officer urging passengers to get aboard quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation urging haste, and an invitation to step in or aboard.

clue.text: Fiddle around with the first prune stone

definitions.meaning: to meddle or tamper
in the rhyme counting stones on a plate, '..., tailor, soldier, sailor', this trade comes first

explanation.surface: Toying with the first stone left from a dessert of prunes.
explanation.walkthrough: British children count plum or prune stones with the rhyme 'Tinker, tailor, soldier, sailor' to foretell whom they will marry.
explanation.definitionFit: To potter with something; also the opening word of the counting rhyme said over fruit stones.

clue.text: Sponger turned dim-wit one hour later

indicators.note: turned round, so the word for a dim-wit is read backwards

parts.note: a dim-wit is a fool
a is one

explanation.surface: A freeloader who proved to be an idiot an hour afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A bath sponge made from the fibrous dried gourd.

clue.text: Identify chap as a sinecurist

parts.note: to place someone is to recognise who they are
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: Recognising a man as someone in a cushy job.
explanation.definitionFit: A political appointee given a post for patronage rather than work, so holding an easy job.

clue.text: How a keen person views his updated savings book?

definitions.text: How a keen person views his updated savings book?

parts.words: How a keen person views his updated savings book?
parts.note: an eager person looks on keenly, and an updated passbook has accrued the bank's payments added

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means eagerly, and also describing a sum plus what the bank pays on it.

clue.text: South east Italy on foot

definitions.meaning: the boot-shaped peninsula's south-eastern tip, Apulia
the back part of the foot below the ankle

explanation.surface: Travelling round southern Italy by walking.
explanation.definitionFit: Italy is shaped like a boot, so its south-eastern tip is named after the rear of a foot.

clue.text: Two circles join for a record dance

parts.note: a disc is a circle
O is circle-shaped

explanation.surface: Two rings linking up, perhaps for a dance-floor stunt.
explanation.definitionFit: A party where people dance to recorded pop music.

clue.text: A hundred and one conifers may come from it

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A hundred and one pine trees growing from a single source.
explanation.definitionFit: Pine trees grow from seeds held in the scaly fruit they shed.

clue.text: Age is disconnected with sponsorship

indicators.note: broken apart, so these letters are separated and reassembled

explanation.surface: Old age is cut off from patronage.
explanation.definitionFit: Under someone's protection or backing, from Zeus's shield.

clue.text: Noble Russian lad confronts a king

parts.note: a lad is a boy
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A Russian aristocrat's son standing up to a king.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the old aristocracy of Muscovy, ranking below a prince.

clue.text: Go through the ceiling and cause a rumpus

definitions.meaning: literally, lift the top of a building
to make a huge noise or fuss

explanation.surface: Someone shooting upwards through the ceiling while making a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally hoisting the top of a building; figuratively making an uproar.

clue.text: Scalp a young thug

definitions.meaning: the covering of the top of the head
a shaven-headed youth associated with violence

explanation.surface: Scalping a young hooligan.
explanation.definitionFit: The scalp is literally the covering of the head; also a shaven-headed gang member.

clue.text: Leave office to walk over open countryside

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed above, so before, the next

parts.note: a step is a walking move
a down is rolling open upland, as in the South Downs

explanation.surface: Quitting a job to go rambling over the hills.
explanation.walkthrough: Downs are open grassy chalk hills in southern England.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign a position, giving way to another.

clue.text: Pack nice bits in tidy order!

definitions.text: Pack nice bits in tidy order!

indicators.note: putting things in order means rearranging them, so these letters are sorted afresh

explanation.surface: Instructions to fill a hamper neatly with tasty food.
explanation.definitionFit: A wicker hamper for an outdoor meal, packed with tasty items.

clue.text: Carriage for a Soviet physicist

definitions.meaning: a four-wheeled horse-drawn vehicle with a folding hood
Lev ..., Nobel prize winner for superfluid theory

explanation.surface: Transport for a scientist from the USSR.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse-drawn coach with a folding top, and the surname of a Nobel-winning Soviet scientist.

clue.text: Fool goes in to lay money on a dog

indicators.note: one word enters another, sitting inside it

parts.note: to bet is to stake money
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: An idiot walks in to gamble on a racing dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A short-legged hound breed with long ears.

clue.text: A fish jelly

parts.note: a gar is a long-snouted freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A jellied fish dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A gelatinous substance from seaweed used for setting food and growing cultures.

clue.text: Ancient city of favourite sun god

parts.note: a pet is a favourite
Ra was the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: An old city belonging to a beloved solar deity.
explanation.definitionFit: The rock-cut Nabataean city in Jordan.

clue.text: Click your fingers and go click

definitions.meaning: to make a sharp noise with thumb and finger
to break or shut with a sharp crack

explanation.surface: Instruction to make a clicking noise with the fingers.
explanation.definitionFit: Fingers make a sharp crack; a twig or catch breaks or shuts with the same sound.

clue.text: On foreign affairs his pronouncement is heard

indicators.note: a pronouncement is something said aloud, so the word is taken by sound

parts.note: heard is the past tense of hear

explanation.surface: A minister's statement on foreign policy is listened to.
explanation.walkthrough: Douglas Hurd was British Foreign Secretary from 1989 to 1995, so the clue points to him through his job.
explanation.definitionFit: Douglas Hurd was the British Foreign Secretary, the minister responsible for overseas relations.

clue.text: Cloak given to Georgia

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: A cape handed to someone from Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: The loose outer garment worn by citizens of ancient Rome.

clue.text: Anxiety caused by underworld silence

parts.note: Dis is the Roman underworld, or its ruler
silence is quiet

explanation.surface: Unease brought on by the hush of the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of worry or unease.

clue.text: Arrive at a state of consciousness apparently

definitions.meaning: to reach a total or place
recovering one's senses after fainting

explanation.surface: Waking up into awareness, seemingly.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach an amount, and to regain one's senses after passing out.

clue.text: Till now it is thought of as being modern

definitions.meaning: covering everything to the present
current and fashionable

explanation.surface: Something regarded as contemporary so far.
explanation.definitionFit: As far as the present moment, and also current or fashionable.

clue.text: What those involved take to give to the police?

definitions.meaning: participants take a share or part
to surrender something to the authorities

explanation.surface: Accomplices in a crime turning something over to the law.
explanation.definitionFit: Participants have a part in something; also to surrender lost property to the authorities.
